name: skeleton
description: The shape of content that has not arrived. Worth having as a unit for one reason: a skeleton that does not match the size of what replaces it causes the layout to jump, which is a Core Web Vitals failure and reads as a bug.

reducedMotion.$description: Still visible, no longer pulsing — the shape is the message, the pulse was only reassurance.

a11y.note: `aria-hidden`, always. A skeleton is a placeholder for the eye; announcing it says nothing useful and reading a screenful of them says it repeatedly. The REGION being loaded carries `aria-busy=true` instead, so a screen reader is told once that something is coming.
